verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail publishes a $20 per-check deposit fee. It names Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo as the banks that get complimentary overnight shipping. It also states that the physical check is mailed directly to your bank of deposit. Turnaround is implied only by the 'overnight shipping' mention, the full list of supported banks is not stated, and no processing timeline is given. missing for 10: explicit end-to-end deposit turnaround/processing time, complete list or policy on which banks are supported, shipping terms for non-listed banks, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, check deposit terms are published — supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, and what happens to the physical check afterward

citations.quote: $20 per check; complimentary overnight shipping is provided for checks deposited into accounts with Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo.
Deposit checks into your bank account by having the checks mailed directly to your bank of deposit.
Checks forwarded directly to your bank so you can get paid faster (additional fees apply)
